setup_notes: Initial source build needed Python development headers; local existing headers were supplied without modifying system packages.
Base interpreter lacked psutil; suite was launched with the isolated benchmark interpreter.
First Data-Juicer import attempted automatic Ray/Torch installation; setup worker was stopped and that comparison is excluded.
Ray 2.59.0 and CPU Torch 2.15.0+cpu were prepared outside subsequent timed invocations.
Measured trials run offline, verify environment versions before/after, and include all planned trials.
source_revision_meaning: Commit containing the exact frozen experiment files. Initial invocations started before this local commit existed; file hashes identify executed code.
